thread:
sam: Assessor intake update: they want a signed evidence bundle + RBAC diff before retest scheduling. Can we confirm process and SLA today?
lina: Short answer: baseline snapshot, triage, patch, post-patch snapshot, then retest booking. We need to lock retest SLAs in the ticket.
priya: I'll own snapshots. We'll publish baseline to gs://evidence-exports/assessments/<eng-id>/baseline.json and include sha256.
dave: Ops constraints: presigned links max 30 days. If the assessor requires longer, we mirror to evidence-archive (90d) after window and record checksums.
sam: Good. Assessor also asked for a KMS usage log (key ops) and a KV cache trace around any mitigation steps. Keep traces minimal.
lina: Triage SLA proposal: ack within 8h, initial triage in 24h, P1/P2 fixes aim for 72h. Retest hold: ops reserves a contingent morning slot within 48-72h for P1/P2.
priya: Commands I'll run for baseline (example):
```
./tools/rbac-snapshot --out /tmp/rbac-177888-base.json
sha256sum /tmp/rbac-177888-base.json > /tmp/rbac-177888-base.sha256
gsutil cp /tmp/rbac-177888-base.json gs://evidence-exports/assessments/177888/baseline.json
gsutil cp /tmp/rbac-177888-base.sha256 gs://evidence-exports/assessments/177888/
```
dave: For KMS: we'll create ephemeral role arn:aws:sts::...:assumed-role/assess-kms-177888 with TTL 6h, scoped to decrypt/test-key. Key usage will be exported to key-usage-audit stream.
priya: I'll also produce an "evidence-readme.md" that documents redaction policy, included fields, and the exact commands used. Assessor gets presigned links; archive mirror stored separately.
sam: Security-bot, please open an intake ticket and seed the checklist: baseline snapshot, presigned bundle, KMS ephemeral role, runtime traces, archive mirror, retest hold.
security-bot: Created SEC-3566: "Evidence baseline & retest booking". Checklist added and assigned to priya/dave. Reminder set 24h before window.
ops-oncall: Holding contingent retest slots Mon/Tue 09:00-12:00 UTC. Note: if fixes require infra changes touching prod topology, retest may need a staging slot instead; we'll flag in the ticket.
lina: Remediation workflow: 1) baseline snapshot (priya) 2) assessor runs tests 3) findings filed to SEC-3566 4) team triages and patches 5) post-patch snapshot + md5 manifest 6) request retest (use contingent slot) 7) assessor verifies and marks finding resolved.
pirka: (typo) priya: Also adding a small KV-trace capture step to the post-patch runbook: two 60s samples, focus=kv_evictions, output runtime-traces.tar.gz.
sam: One more: include an "evidence-accepted" checkbox in each finding so assessor can mark verification time. We'll record verification timestamp in the ticket.
priya: Dry-run scheduled Thu 2026-05-08 13:00 UTC to validate presigned links and archive mirroring. Will post presigned URLs + ephemeral role ARN in this thread after dry-run.
sam: Action items summarized: priya -> baseline + README + presigned bundle; dave -> ephemeral KMS role + mirror; lina -> triage SLA + board column; ops-oncall -> hold retest slots + rotate creds after window; security-bot -> SEC-3566 tracking.
priya: Copy. Will post baseline link after the dry-run. :white_check_mark:
sam: Thanks everyone. If anything blocks, escalate to #incidents and ping @ops-oncall.
